notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry and one family obituary profile were read; the Weebly Barge page is a name-and-county stub. The brief says status standing, but no page read states the tower's current condition, so facts.status is unknown. The register's agency name differs from the 1985 company name (Barge Forest Products Co.); kept as NHLR wrote it. Two searches found no construction history or staffing record. The obituary profile does not mention a tower: a full-text check for lookout, tower, watch, fire and observation found no matches. Re-checked 2026-10-09: NHLR shows Elevation 586 ft (179 m), Built Unknown, and Administered by C.A. Barge Forest Products. The story's advice about visiting or climbing the tower was not supported by any source and was removed.
